description: This script analyzes source code to find deprecated registerHttpHandler calls in TypeScript/JavaScript files, and runs a guard to detect such calls at runtime.

methods.name: isDeprecatedRegisterHttpHandlerCall
methods.description: Checks if a given expression is a property access expression with the property name 'registerHttpHandler'.

methods.name: findDeprecatedRegisterHttpHandlerLines
methods.description: Parses the provided content and collects lines where deprecated 'registerHttpHandler' calls are made.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that sets up and runs the callsite guard to detect deprecated plugin API calls.
